August has arrived, and deals like $50 off AirPods Pro 3, $100 off AirPods Max 2, and the all-time low on AirTag 2 are still going strong. But today's 9to5Toys "Midday Roundup" lead is the M5 MacBook Air — we spotted a rare $200 discount on the 24GB/512GB model, plus up to $300 off select configurations at the official Apple Certified Refurbished store, including this 24GB 15-inch model (more on that here). The deals also include nearly $100 off various Apple Watch Ultra 3 configurations, the latest Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable in black for $18, and a chance to score translucent red Beats Solo Buds for as low as $40. Read on for all the details.

Official Apple Refurbished Store now selling M5 MacBook Air at lowest prices, up to $300 off

The latest MacBook lineup has seen price increases at retail, and while we've tracked multiple deals with up to $500 off, the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is offering some of the best discounts on select M5 MacBook Air configurations. We've featured the lowest-priced base model from a trusted source before, but you can also grab the 24GB 15-inch model for $300 below new pricing, available in Midnight Black, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

The official Apple Refurbished Store is now selling the 15-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 1TB storage for $1,699 (shipping included). As mentioned above, this deal applies to all four colors: Midnight Black, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This MacBook Air was originally priced at $1,900, and currently every configuration on Amazon is going for over $1,999.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB for $1,099 (originally $1,299 new) — $200 off
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB for $1,359 (originally $1,599 new) — $240 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB for $1,699 (originally $1,999 new) — $300 off

Today's Apple refurb deals bring this machine back to historical pricing levels and represent the best discounts we've tracked since the price increase took effect. It looks like these new MSRPs will stick around through the end of the year and possibly longer. While this isn't the lowest price we've ever recorded, it's a very notable savings opportunity for anyone looking to pick up an M5 MacBook Air this year — the next MacBook Air lineup isn't expected to hit this price point again until mid-2027 at the earliest.

Browse all MacBook deals at the Apple Refurbished Store now — use the filters on the left side of the page to select your desired model.

Best-priced 15-inch 24GB M5 MacBook Air gets $200 discount today

Ongoing: Amazon today launches $500 off deal on 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro

MacBook pricing has just gone up, but Amazon is still offering a massive $500 discount on the 24GB/2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro this morning. This price is close to the lowest we've tracked before the price increase took effect. Read on for details.

Amazon is now selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB storage for $2,499 (shipping included).

Considering this machine is regularly priced at $2,999 at Apple and other channels, you can now save a full $500. Both Space Black and Silver models are eligible for this deal.

Since the major retailers raised prices, this is the best deal we've tracked on M5 Pro models.

Before today, Amazon's best discount on this machine was $300, but it's now been slashed by another $200.

While this price hasn't yet reached the levels we tracked before the price increase, that's beyond our control and there's no going back. Overall, considering the price hike on this machine about a month ago, this deal is only $100 above the all-time low for the M5 Pro.

Black and Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 models discounted by nearly $100 on Amazon

Update: As expected, Amazon has also dropped prices on several other Ultra 3 configurations, including the Natural Titanium case model with the Anchor Blue Ocean band, at nearly $100 off. Read on for details.

While the Series 11 lineup has seen steady deals, as was the case at the start of August, discounts on the Apple Watch Ultra 3 have been rarer. But this morning we spotted Amazon offering the black Ultra 3 with the black "One Size Fits Most" Ocean band for nearly $100 off.

Amazon is now selling the black titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with the black Ocean band for $699.99 (shipping included).

Regular pricing is $799, and this deal comes within a hair of $100 off, making it the best deal on a new unit from a reputable retailer that we've found.

Aside from the brief $150 discount during Amazon Prime Day, this is one of the best deals of the year and one of the few significant discounts we've seen on Amazon.

As of writing, the black model with the Ocean band is the only configuration seeing significant savings. But if this deal follows the pattern of the last one, we may well see other color configurations get discounted throughout today and this week.

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with black Ocean band for $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Anchor Blue Ocean band for $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Blue Trail Loop for $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop for $800 (originally $899)

If you're after the Series 11, you can grab one for significantly less right now:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 for $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 for $329 (originally $429)

Latest Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable in black drops to $18 with Prime shipping, all-time low (40% off)

Get translucent red Beats Solo Buds for as low as $41 today

We were impressed with the built-in battery life on the Solo Buds — they're the most affordable next-gen Beats wireless earbuds you can buy right now. While the MSRP is $80 and Amazon's regular price is $70, it's an even sweeter deal if you can grab them from Best Buy for $41 (shipping included). Browse all Best Buy Beats deals here, and read on for Solo Buds deal details.

Best Buy is now selling "Premium" condition open-box translucent red Beats Solo Buds for $40.99 (shipping included). That's nearly 50% off the suggested retail price and well below Amazon's $70 price for new units.

  • Functions and appearance like new.
  • Includes all accessories and parts, packaging may differ or be missing.

You're looking at a fairly entry-level pair of earbuds here, but we're talking about the latest generation earbuds from Apple for just $41.

As mentioned above, in our hands-on testing, the earbuds' built-in battery did indeed deliver up to 18 hours of listening time on a single charge. While there's no battery in the non-wireless charging case, for most users — especially at just $41 — the battery life is more than sufficient. Other features include one-touch seamless pairing, custom microphones with "advanced noise reduction algorithms for superior call quality," and industry-leading Class 1 Bluetooth.
